import subprocess,sys,shlex
from pathlib import Path
sha=sys.argv[1];base='e4fc83549131b24583fd9e979ca4ee6f911e401d'
assert len(sha)==40
root='/home/ugrp/ugrp-sim/src/';remote=root+sha
old=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--objects','--no-walk',base]).splitlines()
new=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--objects','--no-walk',sha]).splitlines()
oldids={x.split()[0] for x in old};needed=b'\n'.join(x.split()[0] for x in new if x.split()[0] not in oldids)+b'\n'
subprocess.run(['ssh','azure3',f'test ! -e {remote} && mkdir {remote} && cd {remote} && git init -q && printf %s {root+base+"/.git/objects"} > .git/objects/info/alternates'],check=True)
pack=subprocess.Popen(['git','pack-objects','--stdout'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
cmd=f'cd {remote} && git index-pack --stdin && echo {sha} > .git/shallow && git update-ref HEAD {sha} && git reset --hard {sha} && ln -sfn /home/ugrp/ugrp-sim/ugrp/.venv-sim .venv-sim && git fsck --connectivity-only --no-dangling && echo {sha} > .git/ugrp-source-complete'
recv=subprocess.Popen(['ssh','azure3',cmd],stdin=pack.stdout);pack.stdout.close();pack.stdin.write(needed);pack.stdin.close()

  if [ ! -e "$root/clone-excluded-vm1-20261012/$item" ]; then

import json, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
SUB='88b7ee7f-f2f3-4a0d-a0ce-cf7306943676'
RG='UGRP-SIM-RG'
BASE=f'/subscriptions/{SUB}/resourceGroups/{RG}'
out=Path(__file__).parent
def az(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(['az',*args,'--subscription',SUB,'--only-show-errors','-o','json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError(p.stderr)
    return json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else {}
def save(name,data):
    (out/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')

disk=az('disk','create','-g',RG,'-n','ugrp-sim-azure3-os','--source',BASE+'/providers/Microsoft.Compute/snapshots/ugrp-sim-azure3-source-20261012','--location','koreacentral','--size-gb','128','--sku','StandardSSD_LRS')

import json, sys, uuid, hashlib, datetime
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from scripts.azure_api import Arm, BASE, SUB, ACCOUNT, VM_ID
a=Arm();api='?api-version=2022-04-01';compute='?api-version=2024-11-01';automation='?api-version=2024-10-23'
vm3=VM_ID+'3'
vm=a.request('GET',vm3+compute);principal=vm['identity']['principalId']
old=a.request('GET',VM_ID+compute)['identity']['principalId']
account=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+automation);auto=account['identity']['principalId']
existing=a.request('GET',VM_ID+'/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments'+api)['value']
roles=[];assignments=[]
for row in existing:
 p=row['properties']
 if p['principalId']!=old or p['scope'].lower()!=VM_ID.lower():continue
 role=p['roleDefinitionId']; definition=a.request('GET',role+api)
 actions=definition['properties']['permissions'][0]['actions']
 allowed={'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/read','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/instanceView/read','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/deallocate/action','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommands/read','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommands/write'}
 if not set(actions)<=allowed:continue
 roles.append({'id':role,'actions':actions})
 for who in ([principal,auto] if 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommands/write' in actions else [principal]):
  name=uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL,vm3+who+role)
  result=a.request('PUT',vm3+f'/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/{name}'+api,{'properties':{'roleDefinitionId':role,'principalId':who,'principalType':'ServicePrincipal'}})
  assignments.append(result['properties'])
assert len(assignments)==3,assignments
runbook=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/runbooks/Stop-UgrpVMs'+automation)
content=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/runbooks/Stop-UgrpVMs/content'+automation)
assert '/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines?api-version=' in content
assert '$total -ge 150' in content and '2026-11-18T15:00:00Z' in content
schedules={name:a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/schedules/'+name+automation)['properties'] for name in ['daily-backup-kst','credit-expiry-kst','hourly-credit-check']}
assert all(p['isEnabled'] for p in schedules.values())
jobs=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/jobSchedules'+automation)['value']
bindings=[]
for job in jobs:
 p=a.request('GET',job['id']+automation)['properties']
 if p.get('runbook',{}).get('name')=='Stop-UgrpVMs':bindings.append(p)
budget=a.request('GET',f'/subscriptions/{SUB}/providers/Microsoft.CostManagement/budgets/ugrp-credit-20261011?api-version=2025-03-01')['properties']
discovered=a.request('GET',f'/subscriptions/{SUB}/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines'+compute)['value']
assert vm3.lower() in [v['id'].lower() for v in discovered]
result={'checked_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'vm':vm3,'principal':principal,'automation_principal':auto,'roles':roles,'assignments':assignments,'runbook':{'state':runbook['properties']['state'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest(),'discovery':'same subscription VM list query discovers VM3; no shutdown runbook invoked','vm3_discovered':True,'stop_usd':150,'expiry_utc':'2026-11-18T15:00:00Z'},'schedules':schedules,'bindings':bindings,'budget':budget}
Path('outputs/azure-vm3-setup/cloud-safety.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('VM3-only assignments',len(assignments),'published',runbook['properties']['state'],'schedule bindings',len(bindings))
